authenticity.evidence: No organic social presence found: no X, Reddit or Telegram hits for the contract or the name, and no socials or website in the packet (https://api.dexscreener.com/latest/dex/tokens/66kXpKjMJDHnUHZqKkcMHwMo1sKGhf2aa3EBoPCi1rYc). Trading looks like bots: in the last 5 minutes there were ~316 buys and ~311 sells from ~99 unique buyers and ~95 unique sellers, so the same wallets are cycling buys and sells. The 1-hour figure of 1116 unique buyers against only 109 sellers fits a scripted wallet spray. GMGN flags 21 bundler wallets. The packet lists 10 earlier 'Penguin Cat' tokens with the symbol 'Hybrid cat', launched over the past ~23h, all now at $0 or $0.01 liquidity. That points to a repeated launch-and-pull operation.
authenticity.uncertainty: I can't prove the dead clones share an operator with this deployer. GMGN shows the creator with 0 prior launches, but fresh deployer wallets are cheap to make.

structured_output.counterargument: The volume is large relative to the market cap ($280k in 1h on $50k), the price has already doubled once, the top 10 wallets hold only 13.6% outside the pool, and GMGN shows the creator holding 0% with no honeypot or taxes. Some of the earlier clones also appear to have printed $1-2M market caps (possibly stale values) before dying, so for a short window this format has produced spikes.
